Now, if we could be -- if you could be so kind, Mr. Usher, to provide our witness with -- I just have three documents. It's a rare occasion where we only have three, but such is the day.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Sorry, what number is it?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: You can see there's an order?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yeah.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: If you go to the very last page you'll see that it's -- you'll see that actually it's in B/C/S. That's what we call the languages for shorthand, you know, Bosnian, Croatian, Serbian. And we see it's handwritten. Obviously we don't see a stamp or anything like that, but I'm sure in the field you've -- you've had to write out orders as such. Now, did they show you this particular order, that this was -- and this has already been admitted into evidence so I'm not disclosing anything new to -- to the Bench, but did they had show you this order that was issued by General Petkovic? And it would have been somewhere in the neighbourhood of the 20th or thereafter, because if we look at paragraph 2, General Petkovic is quite clear. "Obey in full the order of the of president of the HZ HB/Croatian Community of Herceg-Bosna Mate Boban ..." Or whoever was receiving it in. This case I it would have been, I believe, the people on the ground including Colonel Siljeg. You know, "...dated 19 January 1993, and my order of 20 January 1993." Do you see that?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I have it here in front of me.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. Was this shown to you?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: When?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Well, either by Mr. Spork or by Mr. Stringer to, you know, sort of recollect as to who gave the order? Because it seems -- I mean, one of the issues that seems that you're brought here is to talk about command responsibility or superior responsibility, effective command and control and communications. The three Cs.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: The three Cs, yep.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I can't remember if Mr. Spork showed me this.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. But at least from this order, assuming the order is --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] One of the Judges has a question.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MINDUA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I apologise, Mr. Karnavas. This refers to previous orders, but could we establish the exact date?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Well, Mr. -- Your Honour, I see that my colleague is on her feet, and I believe this might have been a document that was -- or my colleague can explain it.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Ms. Alaburic.

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, this is an order dated the 24th of January, 1993. It is a document which we have under P 01286, and I will be using that document. And everyone can see from the database that that is the date of the document. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MINDUA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Very well. Thank you for this clarification.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Microphone, please, Mr. Karnavas.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: All right. Now, I want to show you another document, and this is 1D 01521. 1521. I suspect we haven't seen this document, but --

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. But let's look at the second page first of all.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Can I -- am I in a position to read this now?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Well, we're going to go step-by-step. I'm going to walk you through it. I'm not going to mislead you. Trust me. First, let me get back -- I'm just going to get some foundational questions and I'll give you -- I'll give you a chance. Okay? So are you with me?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, absolutely.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. Second page. We see that this is signed in Mostar, January 18, 1993, and we have Mate Boban and Mile Akmadzic. Do you see that?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I do.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. Now did you know who Mile Akmadzic was at the time?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I can't recollect.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. Doesn't ring a bell?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: No memory at all?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: It says president of the government of RBiH. What does RBiH stand for? I'll give you help. Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina. Would that be it?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yeah, yeah. Yep.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yep, yep.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: And do you know what the president of the government, what that function entails?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Of -- of the Republic of Bosnia-Herzegovina?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Yeah. I mean in the structure of things.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Where was he in the chain of command?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Well, not the chain of command. I mean, how was -- what exactly the function was of the president of the government. Well, let me back up. Do you know any -- you told us you knew nothing about how the government of the Croatian Community of Herceg-Bosna was structured. Do you have any idea of how the government or how, you know, the Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina was structured? And I refrain from using the word "government" because in this context it has a particular meaning?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yeah.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: So do you know? Did anybody explain it to you?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I go back to what I said originally: My job was in the field.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: I didn't ask you about that. I'm just asking you a simple question.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: So, no.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: I'm just a simple lawyer asking simple questions.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I'm a simple soldier.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Exactly.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yeah.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: So what you're telling us is being a simple soldier --

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: -- you knew nothing about the political structure?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: The question you've asked me.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Oh, the question I've asked you. All right. Did you -- had you heard of Mr. Izetbegovic?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. And what was his role if you -- if you recollect? Did anybody explain to you who Mr. Alija Izetbegovic was?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: He was the leader -- from what I remember, he was the leader of the Republic of Bosnia-Herzegovina. What his title was I'm not sure.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: All right. Were you aware that he was during October 1992 in and around Mostar?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Was I aware of that?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Yes. Did anybody bring it to your attention?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: No. What date in October?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. Well, he was there for several weeks. Now, we know that you went to -- you went into Mostar the last week, you say, of October but you're not quite clear.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yeah.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I wasn't aware that he was there and I didn't meet him.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. All right. Did you ever make any attempts meet with him?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: To meet Mr. Izetbegovic?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. Now, getting back to this document --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PRANDLER
utterances.text: Please, let me ask you again, Mr. Karnavas and also our witness, to slow down and to have a break between your questions and answers. As I used to say, you will kill the interpreters, and it is not a very good thing to do. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: I totally agree, Your Honour. In fact, I was reprimanded last night and correctly so.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. Getting back to this document. I just want you -- if you wanted to glean at it very quickly but I'm more interested in the last paragraph on the first page where it says: "The minister of defence of Bosnia and Herzegovina commanded with our approval that all three national armies, in accordance with Geneva Conference, should withdraw to their respective provinces, which should be a good move as regards the aggressor Serb army, which also has to withdraw. Thus the decision of HVO is merely the implementation of that order. At the same time, this moment has been qualified as appropriate for establishment of Joint Command of BiH defence armies (Army of BiH and HVO), to which you opposed." Now, let's stop there. I take it from your previous answers, not having seen the Vance-Owen Peace Plan that was being generated out of the Geneva Conference, you at that time, because you were in the field, boots on the ground as it were, did not know exactly what was happening in Geneva.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: That's a fair comment.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. And did anybody tell you by any chance what, if any, agreements had been reached, tentative as they may have been, between Mr. Izetbegovic and Mate Boban?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I was aware that there was a question of subordination of the Armija under HVO control.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. But that wasn't my question. I was -- I talked about agreements.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: That's -- no. To answer your question, no.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Now, it says here in the very last sentence --

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Could I read the document from the start.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Let me just do my cross?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Okay, yeah.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: And then, you know, we'll have a break and then you can read that and we'll go back to this document. "At the same time, this moment has been qualified as appropriate for establishment of Joint Command of BiH defence armies, army of BiH, and HVO to which you opposed." Did anyone bring to your attention that this -- the establishment of a Joint Command had been on the table, had been proposed by Mr. Mate Boban, and it would appear that Mr. Mile Akmadzic, the president of the RBiH, they're representing that this proposal was on the table and Mr. Alija Izetbegovic opposed, opposed it. Did anybody bring that to your attention?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. Finally if we go to the -- to the -- to the paragraph that starts with "However," and I don't want to spend too much time dwelling on it, but I'm going to go to the very last sentence where it says: "Accusing the Republic of Croatia of interfering with the internal issues of Bosnia and Herzegovina is an excuse for furthering one's own agenda, and for public dismissal of Friendship and Cooperation Agreement between the two states." Question: Were you aware, sir, of whether -- let's just start with whether, whether there was such an agreement, a Friendship and Cooperation Agreement? Did anybody bring that to your attention?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Negative.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. Would it be surprised -- would you be surprised to learn that there was, in fact, a Friendship -- an Agreement of Friendship and Cooperation between the Republic of Croatia and the Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Would I be surprised?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. All right. Now, did you have any dealings in particular with the Republic of Croatia? I mean, other than going there once a week, as you said, did you have any dealings, official dealings, with them?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: And I think yesterday you were asked the questions whether you had seen the HV.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: The Croatian army. And you indicated in your rather -- and I noted this, I think I'm going to have to go to the record to make sure I didn't get it wrong. I'm referring to yesterday's transcript of page 79, and it says here: Question -- he's asking you about "at the end of Mr. Bousseau's report, he's recounting some submissions made by Mr. Pasalic" - And we talked who Mr. Pasalic was - "But there's a reference to units and equipment of the Croatian army, the HV, and I wanted to ask you whether you observed or encountered Croatian army units or equipment during the course of your tour in the region." Now -- and then the answer, the answer that you give, it was quite laconic: "Yeah on a number of occasions only in Mostar we observed some Croatian army vehicles." That's what you said. You're shaking your head?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. You stand by that?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I said that, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Well, I know that you stand by saying that that's what you said, but you stand by that --

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: -- answer.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: And I take it what was being shown to you or what was being referenced to Mr. Bousseau's report, those would have been encounters he had with Mr. Pasalic, information that he had gleaned or learned from Mr. Pasalic; correct?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. Now, you were questioned about this -- and by the way when we say vehicles, a tank is not a vehicle, is it, in the military sense? When you refer to a vehicle, if you say I saw some vehicles. If you say I saw a tank you would say I saw a tank?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: You would make that distinction?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: You would.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Maybe a civilian like me who is not terribly sophisticated might make that error, but you certainly would not, being the military man you are?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Now, Mr. President, perhaps we can take the break and we could pick up there because we've gone an hour and a half.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] We are going to have a break of about 20 minutes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Before we resume with the cross-examination, the Chamber renders its oral decision following the oral request made by Mr. Scott this morning. The Chamber considers that the exceptional circumstances referred to have been demonstrated by the Prosecution and as a result the Chamber grants the Prosecution the possibility of responding pursuant to its initial motion, but I'd like to point out to the Prosecution that the reply must only relate to elements that come out of -- that arise out of the Defence position. You should not take advantage of the reply to introduce new elements that did not fall within the scope of what the Defence contested, because if that is the case, we will simply dismiss any new elements that might be introduced by these means. The reply is not a procedure that would allow one party to add new elements in relation to the counter-position alleged by one of the parties. Please pay attention to this. The reply should only relate to contested elements, elements contested by the Defence. This is what we wanted to draw your attention to. And secondly, I would once more like to remind the Defence that they should slow down because we'll be breaking all records today. We have had about 54 pages in an hour and a half and that's an absolute record in this Tribunal. Mr. Karnavas, please proceed.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President. Thank you, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] And I'd like to add that I would like to greet Mr. Kovacic, who is back with us now.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Thank you, yes, we do appreciate his presence. It's always good to have him behind me as support.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: You heard the President. We need to slow down, sir.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Absolutely.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Now, before we took a break I'd asked you some questions -- you don't need to pay attention to that document any more unless you -- unless we get back to it, so we can --

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: -- just focus on my -- the last series of questions where I directed you to what you had said yesterday on direct examination concerning the HV, and in your statement on paragraph 50, for instance, you made comments to the effect that -- or this is what Mr. Spork wrote down as your account: "The HVO had a proper military structure, a chain of command with arsenal of military materiel from small arms up to anti-tank weaponry. Tank supports for the HVO was supplied by the HV. I know this because on a number of occasions I witnessed tanks with HV designation in Mostar." Let's stop right there. Today, based on what you told me, at least on cross-examination and based on what you told the Prosecution yesterday on direct examination, I would take it you would want to withdraw that part of your statement. That's incorrect, is it?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Incorrect, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. It's kind of hard to miss a tank if it's rolling down the streets of Mostar, isn't it?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's a long time ago, yeah.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: But my question is it's hard to miss --

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: It is, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. May I ask, and I'm doing this with the utmost respect, recognising that memory fades with time, unlike wine, it doesn't get any better, at least not for some of us, when you read this before you initialed it, okay, was this something that you constantly saw or was this something that sort of was put in and maybe perhaps overlooked by you? I mean, in other words, is it possible that during the interviewing session that maybe you were pressed and maybe didn't give -- because we don't have the question, answer, we don't have a live transcript like we do with some witnesses so we don't know what the question was and we don't know what your answer was. Do you recollect by any chance?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Now, staying with that paragraph, you indicate something that I found rather interesting. Perhaps may wish to comment. You say both sides admitted to uncontrolled elements, but I'm only aware of a number of mercenaries that might fall in that category, mainly German and British operating with the HVO." Now, my -- now, yesterday you were shown a document by the Prosecution, and that was document number 1303. Granted it was not generated by you, but there was a reference there to Islamic fighters. Do you recall seeing that passage where it makes reference to that?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I'd like to read it if you're going to --

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. I was just going to suggest that.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. And may I ask, thus far I hope you don't feel that you've been mistreated by the Defence.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, absolutely not.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. If we could get the documents, they can be either pulled up or these would be in the Prosecution bundle 1303. But if you get to it, and we look at -- it's numbered paragraph 3. It's numbered, a numbered paragraph. And there is this sort of reference to Islamist forces. It says: "Danger just for the whole area obvious for the outcome of the Geneva talks for the fate of the population, as well as for the possibility interference of Islamist forces encouraged by the victimisation of the Muslim community."

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Just give me the reference to that again please.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: 1303. This was a document that was shown to you by the Prosecution yesterday obviously shown to you and gone over with you by Mr. Stringer?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I have it here, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Paragraph 3, it makes a reference to Islamist forces. Okay? Now, the reason I'm asking this question going back to paragraph 50, you're saying that you mainly saw -- or what you saw: "I'm only aware of a number of mercenaries which might fall in the category -- in that category," meaning the category of uncontrolled elements quote unquote, "mainly German and British operating with the HVO."

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Now my question is because at least we have a reference from your supervisor or your superior, my question is did you, Mr. Ray Lane, ECMM monitor, team leader, did you know then or were you aware of the involvement of the Mujahedin --

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: That's pretty laconic.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, counsel.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: You mean period, full stop?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: No more -- so I want to make sure I got this right. Help me out here.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Sure.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: From mid-October -- or late October when you get there, I think it's mid -- the 30th of October.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Mm-hmm.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: That's a yes; right? Until the middle of March when you leave.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: While you were there on the ground and as I understand it January, February, March, primarily in the Gornji Vakuf area, that area --

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: -- you don't hear anything about Mujahedin?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, that's not what I answered.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: I'm going step-by-step?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Sorry, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Because I --

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I did hear. Yes, I heard.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, for sure, rumours and stories about the presence of Mujahedin.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. Because I asked you did you know then or were you aware of involvement. Now, let me break it down. You heard stories. Were you -- did you do anything to find out whether those stories were correct or incorrect or mere fantasy? It's a yes or no or I don't know?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't know.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. All right. Was this known by others, other than Mr. Ray Lane?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Was what known?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: The rumours, because we can't substantiate their presence, I take it, but was it known, was the rumour known of Mujahedin running around in areas where there was the conflict or --

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. And did you bother to -- when you heard those rumours, did that concern you at all?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Again I remind you of what you said.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: I just?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, no.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Of course it concerned me. Of course it concerned me.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: That's all you need to answer?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Of course it concerned me.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: And you need to slow down.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Sorry.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: And because you were concerned with other matters, I take it you didn't look into it.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, as I said to you previously, we were so busy with all matters that -- that if Mujahedin had been in our area of operations or they were present there, I'm sure we would have found them.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: All right. Do you know where they were present?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Did you ask where they were present?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I can't remember.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: All right. But yet you said that both sides admitted to uncontrolled elements, and then you go on to say, "I am only aware of a number of mercenaries that might fall in that category, mainly German, British, operating with the HVO."

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: By that I mean.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Let me just finish my question.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Sorry. Yep.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: May I ask you why you didn't also include the rumours about the Mujahedin being in and around the area?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Because there's a distinct difference.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: The difference is I met these uncontrolled elements or mercenaries physically.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Where I didn't have the luck of meeting the other people, if they were there.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. If they were there.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Do you know if they were there now? I mean, you were ECMM?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't know. I don't know.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. All right. Now, moving on, the reason I asked you about the Republic of Croatia, you do make a statement in -- there are two passages that I want to -- one is on paragraph 112 of your statement where you say rather boldly: "In my professional opinion that throughout my period of time in the area of operations the Republic of Croatia was a major influence both politically and militarily with the Bosnian Croats and their activity." Okay? And then you go on to say: "On many occasions I saw military hardware with Croatian army designation and military personnel wearing the uniform of the Croatian army. I believe that the Bosnian Croats saw no future for the Bosnian Muslims. There is no doubt that the influence of the European Union and the future ambitions of people like Boban and Jadranko Prlic ensured that these people were very conscious of not upsetting the European Union. However, they had contempt for the United Nations." And -- and I believe there's another reference, and that would be on page 45 where you're talking about at least Boban and his cohorts wanting to live in a Greater Croatia as a society based on Catholicism, and then you go on to say: "It appeared to me their major political direction was unification with the Republic of Croatia." Now, with that in background, having set the stage there, you've told us that your involvement on the ground and your particular interest was the well-being of, you know -- well, your main focus was trying to calm the situation, I guess, in the Gornji Vakuf area. That took up three months of your time at least; right? Or two and a half, January, February. And you left in the middle of March. Right?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: That's correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. I take it in between that time there was a two-week R and R?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Two -- 10 days.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Ten days. And then you told us that your total mission with ECMM was six months?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Three weeks of those were spent in Knin?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Mm-hmm.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: That's a yes?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I'm not quite sure if it was three weeks.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: That's what you told us.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Around that time.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: I'm just telling you what you told us.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I've also pointing out it's a long time ago so I'm not specific on time.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. Slow down, Mr. Lane. Slow down. I abstained from coffee over the break. I just want you to know that.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Maybe I should have too.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Yeah. Now, okay, so we spent two or three weeks that is to say in Knin, then a one-week orientation, plus ten days, so if we subtract that the total amount of time more or less is about five months in Bosnia, give or take a week or so.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Okay. I'll accept that.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. Three months of which or two and a half months of which you spent in the Gornji Vakuf area. The other two months or so would have been going all over the place, including Mostar.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. You were not involved in any negotiations at a high level dealing with Vance-Owen Peace Plan.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: You were not privy to any information resulting from those continuing negotiations?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: You didn't come across any documents?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: You had no dealings with any Croatian officials?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: All right. And here you're saying that it was in your professional opinion that at that time the area of -- "In the area of operations the Republic of Croatia was a major influence both politically and militarily on the Bosnian Croats and their activities." Now, is this -- given what you've told us so far, given your mandate; given what you were doing; given that at least two and a half months, if what you tell us is true, and I have no reason to doubt you that you're spending 14, 15, 16 hours a day, whatever the number might be, negotiating at the very microlevel, how is it that you can say with any degree of certainty that it was your opinion the Republic of Croatia was a major influence politically and militarily, particularly when, as we have seen thus far, you didn't even know how the political structure functioned?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: The answer to your question is the fact that I lived amongst the Bosnian Croat population. My people operated in Herzegovina, and it was our viewpoint as expressed there, that is my viewpoint based on my four or five months in theatre.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. So that's from listening to people on the ground.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: That's from -- you talked about the microlevel. The information you garner from travelling from town to town throughout a region is very, very informative, and what you see is equally as informative. The fact that you might be sitting 16 hours in Gornji Vakuf doesn't mean that you're -- you're not finding out what's going on in the region.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: But your political opinion, if I might be so bold to say, was that my client, Dr. Jadranko Prlic, wanted part of Bosnia and Herzegovina to be annexed to Croatia. At least that's what I glean --

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yeah.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: -- from looking at your statement.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. It was my opinion.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: That's your opinion?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: And that's from conversations on the ground with others than Mr. Jadranko -- Dr. Jadranko Prlic?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I would say it's from being immersed in the population.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. Well, I'm asking this question because you were immersed in the population, let you can't tell me what the Presidency is. You were immersed in the population but you can't tell me, you know, how this government --

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't think that's --

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: -- Functioned?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: But to answer your question I don't they that's relevant to what I'm saying.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I'm saying we were at the level that we saw the people, the response of the people, what their views and future wishes were.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. So now we're talking about the people.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I'm talking about the locations we were in.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. But --

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: But just to answer exactly what you're saying or asking me. I drew my opinion from my extensive movement in the area and discussions with a broad range of people.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: All right.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: That's to answer your question.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. All right. Now, when you had conversations with Mr. -- with Dr. Jadranko Prlic, and as I understand it, again to repeat, you could see him any time you wished?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Absolutely.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: He didn't at any point in time tell you, "No, I'm busy. I don't want to talk to you"?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: He was most forthcoming with his time.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. And to the extent that he was able to answer your questions, he answered them?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: To the extent that he was able to answer them, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. In other words, there wasn't a topic where he would say this is taboo, this is off limits or this is off record or this is not a topic for discussion? And you certainly wouldn't do what you claim Mr. Boban was doing which is sort of switch the topic and talk about something else. There were no sort of ground rules that you would meet with him?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I think that's a fair comment.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. All right. And I think if he had, he said something that was outrageous or outlandish, that's something that you would passed up the chain of command and said, "Well, I had a meeting and this is what this -- this individual said"?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Mm-hmm. Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. All right. Now, yesterday I asked you a question about Mr. Pasalic, and you indicated that -- that he was perturbed, if I could put it that way, he was a little upset over the fact that it took you some time to go to the east side to meet with him; right?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Mm-hmm. Correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Now, when you say the east side, are we talking about the river being --

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: -- the boundary?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Were there not Muslims living on the west side of the river?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I'm sure there were.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: What do you mean are you sure?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: There were. There were, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Would it surprise you to learn that the numbers were rather large? In fact, I'm told, I can't vouch for it, but I'm told that the numbers were probably equal or greater number of Muslims were living on the west side of the bank of the river than on the east side?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. Now, did you have an opportunity to visit those folks prior to meeting -- and those areas prior to going over the -- over the bank?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I cannot remember that.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: All right. You indicated yesterday that -- you told us that his headquarters were -- was on the west -- on the west side?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: That was in the Vranica building?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yeah. I take your word for that, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. Now when you say you take my word for it, is that --

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I cannot remember the name of the building.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. Okay. Does that mean, however, that you remain the location -- you remember the location of the building?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I can see the building in my mind, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. All right. Well, let's walk down memory lane then. Now, that building is fairly -- far removed from the bank, the west bank, of the river. I mean, I'm not talking miles and miles, but it's in the centre of the town; right?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. And it would have been near or further away from, say, where other official buildings were?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Or buildings that were occupied by other -- by officials I would say of the HVO; correct?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Right.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: And that was the headquarters of the 4th -- is it the 4th Corps?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: The 4th Corps.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: That's what they called themselves?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Mm-hmm.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Now in your statement you indicate, and I believe it's on page 67 -- I mean on paragraph -- paragraph 67 in your statement you say something to the effect that you say, "He was the commander of the ABiH 4th Corps. I would always meet General Pasalic in his headquarters on the east side of Mostar."

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Now if he's the commander of the ABiH?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: And if the ABiH has its headquarters on the west side, okay, are you saying that there are two headquarters or ... ? Because I'm a little confused.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, I think it's quite simple I think he had a tactical headquarters on the east side of the bridge.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Tactical versus what? Operational?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: His normal headquarters. In other words, he had another location on the east side of the town.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. Did he ever venture into the west side? And we've had testimony about that.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, I can't personally answer that, but I met him always on the east side.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. Well, was there a particular reason why he would say, "Mr. Lane, we need to meet on the east side and we can't meet on the west side"? Was there a particular reason?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: The -- I think I pointed out yesterday the arrangements I had come to where I would get my people to spend equal time on both sides of the river.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: I understand, but --

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: And --

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: -- there's a difference between -- forgive me for interrupting?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: There's a difference between walking around in your white suit and to be seen, seeing dignitaries and officials, that is difference between that and, say, meeting someone at his headquarters, because as I understand it, it was the headquarters of the ABiH 4th Corps.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Again, I cannot say this categorically, but I think Pasalic's request was to meet him on the east side in his headquarters.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. Very well. Fair enough. And I take it nonetheless because you were there to be fair to everybody, and wanted to find out what each side had, you went into the headquarters in the west side, in the Vranica building?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: In the west side?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Yeah.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I did.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: And did you meet with people over there?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Again, I can't remember who I met there.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: But you did meet -- you were there on official business. It wasn't like let me see what the rooms look like. Is there a television in this room or a telephone working? You were there on official business.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Unofficial or official?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Official.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Everything I did really out there was official business.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: All right. Yet you don't recall who you met?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. Do you recall how many times you went there?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Very few.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Now, as I understand it, by this point in time, from what you were able to glean, there was tension between the Croats and the Muslims?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: All right. There was tension in the air?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: And in fact the tension dealt with or the territory or whatever, the area that was in contention or that was the cause of this tension was in and around the Neretva River; is that correct? The Neretva valley as well.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Could you repeat that?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: The tension was emanating from -- I mean, both sides were -- I believe you say this in your statement some place. The tension had to do with the Neretva. What was the tension about?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: No. I --

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Paragraph 24.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Could you just read it out.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: I'll read it out for you and you help me out here?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: "At the end of October 1992 there was a significant tension in Mostar and it was obvious that the HVO and ABiH were preparing both defence and offensive positions, particularly around the Neretva River." Let me stop right there. So that was the feeling that you got?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: So both sides are preparing.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. Both sides are preparing, as you put it here, defensively and offensively?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: So just to make sure, I don't want to mislead you, I don't want the record to be incorrect. You're not saying one was getting ready offensively --

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: -- And the other defensively?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, absolutely not. No.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay fair enough. Did you ever visit the lines or whatever, the troops to see on both sides?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Did you ever ask to see any maps, for instance? Not that they would share them with you. This is sort of a naive question on my part, but you with your white suit representing the European Union, who knows. They might have answered that question?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I could have asked. I can't remember.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. Now, then you say: "As I subsequently found out, it was extremely difficult to cross the Stari Most bridge and gain access to the east side of Mostar." First of all let's talk about that. Are you with me?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. Now the Stari Most, that's the Old Bridge?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: The Old Bridge, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: You can't drive over it.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: You have to walk over it.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: And as pleasant as it looks, it's kind of a difficult walk.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Mm-hmm.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: That's a yes?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, oh, absolutely.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: In fact, you walked over it the first time when you wanted to see what was happening over there; right?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: That's right.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: The city wasn't divided. That's a question. I forgot to put the inflection. But the city wasn't divided?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: What do you mean it wasn't divided?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Well, you didn't have a line drawn up where, you know, it was one city?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, one city, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: One city?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: You had west and you had east?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: There was a river but it was one city?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: And nobody stopped you from walking across; right?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: All right. Now, the -- as I understand it and help me out, the Serbs they had been attacking -- they had attacked primarily the east side; correct?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. That was because of the locations, where they were located.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Where who was located?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: The -- I don't want to say VRS because they didn't exist at the time or at least that might not have been the unity, the JNA or what they commonly referred to as the Chetniks, a term that I don't -- it's a pejorative term I don't like to use it, but the Serbs?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: That's right.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: They held the high ground?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: To the north.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: They were able to shell, and they were shelling primarily of the east side?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Because that's what -- because of their location?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I'm missing your point.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay, well. I'll move on?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PRANDLER
utterances.text: I'm indeed very sorry but again and again you are overlapping. Also Mr. Lane and also Mr. Karnavas. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Sorry.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: But fair enough, it's fair to say that by the time you got there whatever had happened or for the most part what had happened between the Serbs and the Muslims and the Croats had already finished?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Although there was some shelling?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. And fair enough to say that the east side was the one that was primarily damaged?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. Did you by any chance learn what had happened, how Mostar was liberated? Who did what, who was responsible, what happened? It's a yes or no and --

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. Did you ever ask Mr. Pasalic? Was he general then or colonel?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: General, I think.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. Did you ever ask him to explain to you how the destruction had occurred?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Of Mostar?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Yes, of East Mostar.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Did you ever ask him how it was defended?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Did you ever ask him what exactly had been damaged then as a result of the Serb aggression? That's how it's called. Okay? In other words, and I'm going to get specific on you, to what effect -- to what extent they -- they had damaged the water supply, electricity, phone system, whatever. Things that you need to sustain yourself on a day-to-day basis?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. I was aware that most of the damage in the east side was caused by the Serbs.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: But did you ask for specifics?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Because I think in one of your statements you're saying that the Croats on the west side were denying water, for instance, or electricity to the east side. You're shaking your head.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Now did you ever, sir, in your personal, professional or official, whatever you want to call it, capacity check that situation out to see exactly who controlled the water system, where -- where the problem lied to try to fix it because after all you were the man on the ground concerned, and this would have been one of your concerns. It's again a yes or no, and then we can explain?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Question again, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: I'll be shorter this time. Okay. Did you take any steps, any measures to find out exactly what the cause was, why the east side, for instance, wasn't getting its water?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: The answer is no.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: However, my priority was to -- the second part of your question, my priority was to try and improve the living standards of the people on the east side, on all sides by improving the flow of food, et cetera into that area.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Sir, I have no doubt that that's what you were trying to do.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: But before we can blame one particular side, before we can say this side is denying access of water to another side, would you not agree with me it would help to first find out what the root of the problem is rather than, and forgive me if I say this, making an assumption?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: There was no assumption.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. So --

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: There was no assumption.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Let me -- okay. There was no assumption. Tell me concretely then what it is you learned -- what you did to learn --

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Excuse me.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: And tell us concretely what the problem was with the water because you're asserting at this point that the HVO was deliberately denying the east side water. So I'm asking you, what did you do and how did you draw this conclusion?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I was informed of that by the -- the officials on the east side of the river.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. Now, it would seem to me -- I just heard the news today and there was an allegation against somebody, and someone said, "Hey, wait a minute. There's two side to the stories, and usually the person being accused at least is innocent until presumed -- or unless," you know, "until guilt is proved." You would agree with that?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Absolutely.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. Now, the one side of which you said there is conflict in the air is making this allegation, this assertion. Now, I take it you, based on that answer, accepted that as truth, and that is why you did not make any other efforts to ask -- to find out from the other side what exactly was happening, how the water supply was damaged, if it was damaged, who was turning it off, and why they weren't getting their water.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: No. That wouldn't be a correct assertion.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. Well, tell me concretely. We need to slow down.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Absolutely.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Slow down.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I'm slowing down.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Take a breath.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I'm slowing down.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Take a breath. Tell us concretely then.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: On my visit which I've already informed you to the east side.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I was aware not just of the situation as you keep referring to water but to the humanitarian situation.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Sir, stick with me. I'm dealing with the water issue because you've made assertions, and I'm trying to figure out here, and I'm trying to help the Trial Chamber figure out what exactly you know, because we need to give them the facts. The Trial Chamber, they need the facts. They're going to give us the law. That's how it works?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yeah.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: So I'm asking you concretely because we know that the Serbs, you know, during the first phase destroyed the east side. We know that the water supply was severely damaged. Okay? You're told now on the east side that the Croats who are responsible for the denial of the access of water. Now I'm asking you, sir, concretely did you see and look into the issue of water? Yes or no? I'm not saying whether you asked a question. Did you see where the supply of the water comes, for instance, and whether there was damage and whether you were being lied to? Did you make any efforts? It's a yes or no?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you. We'll move on. You indicated -- you indicated, I believe, that at some point it was difficult having access to the east side; right?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Now, help me out again. If you drive from Dubrovnik up, upwards, and you're driving towards -- into Mostar -- okay? Are you with me?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I am.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. Are you going to get on the west side or the east side?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: When you're driving from where, Dubrovnik?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Yeah.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Straight up the road, you can get on the east side.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: You can straight to the east?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Mm-hmm.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Mm-hmm means yes?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, yes, sir, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: That road wasn't blocked?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: There were check-points on that road.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: There were check-points everywhere according to you and that's true, isn't it?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yep. Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: There were check-points -- I'm getting carried away. There were check-points that were manned by the ABiH; right?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: And there were check-points manned by --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] The Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. STRINGER
utterances.text: Could we perhaps get some idea of the time frame that we're talking about whether it's entire period of the witness's tour or whether there was a more limited period of time. I think it might be helpful.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Very well.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: We're talking about when you get there. So we're talking October, November.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. January, February, March you're in Gornji Vakuf.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Are you able to comment then?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: On Mostar?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Yeah. Whether you could still drive into the -- into East Mostar. I know that there are check-points?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: With difficulty.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. Because I take it as the months go by the tension is growing?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: And there's tension on both sides?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Absolutely.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: And as far as I understand -- and we have to slow down. As far as I understand, and this is what I'm getting from you, there was mistrust on both sides.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: That would be a fair statement.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. And in fact there is a war going around, around them independent of what friction they may be having; right?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: And, sir, you as a military man, help me out here?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: You've been out in Afghanistan. We see the photographs and what's happening in Iraq. We see check-points all the time. Are those illegal check-points or are those a necessary evil brought upon by the circumstances of war? Which of the two?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: The question is --

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: About check-points?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: The check-points, how did they operate.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: I'm asking you in general, going from the --

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: In general.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Yes?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Okay in general, yeah.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Are check-points necessary during that period?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Are check-points necessary? Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: And both sides had them?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: All right. That's all I wanted. Now, just one point I wanted to -- to get at. Yesterday I asked you about your interpreter, translator. I think they call them language assistants?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Mm-hmm.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: That's the term --

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: -- they use these days. You said she was from the west side. Was she Croat or was she Muslim?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I had a number of interpreters.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Well --

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: The girl you're referring to.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Well, woman.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Woman, was Croat, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. This was the very first one?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: But then you had others?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: And the only reason I'm mentioning that is because in paragraph 71 you say -- you maim a statement: "When I finally managed to employ a Muslim interpreter the quantity and quality of information improved immeasurably."

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: So are you saying the Croat interpreters were not very good?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: No that's not what I'm saying at all.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: All right.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I'm saying it was easier, obviously, to bring a Muslim interpreter into a Muslim area.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Right.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: And that's -- that's common sense.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. So let me ask you this. So when you would be talking and meeting with Pasalic, you would have a Muslim interpreter.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I would try.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: It wasn't always possible.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: All right. Fair enough. Another thing that struck me here, on paragraph 70 you say every Saturday afternoon you would walk around East Mostar.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Mm-hmm.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I would try, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Well, it doesn't say I would try. It says I would walk every Saturday afternoon?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: My intent -- my intent would be that every Saturday. I'm not saying I was able to manage it every Saturday afternoon, but the majority of Saturday afternoons I would be there, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. All right. Because I -- that struck me, and I have to tell you why. Just bear with me. Take a pause, relax. It says every Saturday afternoon because you told us that every Saturday morning you were driving to Croatia?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: That's right.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: And you would have a meeting?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: I take it those meetings were rather serious.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, but I would endeavour to return to my office by the afternoon.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: And your office was in?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Siroki Brijeg.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Siroki Brijeg.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yep, yep.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: And then from there?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Just drive into Mostar.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. All right. Fair enough. All right. And I take it when you went there that was also official. You were wearing your white uniform, or were you in civvies?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, throughout the six-month mission we never got out of our white uniform.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. I need to refer to my notes because I'm just about through. I don't have too many more questions. We're wrapping it up. With respect to -- you mentioned yesterday how you saw these refugees in one area. Do you recall that?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Was this Posusje?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: All right. And I know it was asked yesterday, but I wasn't quite clear so I want to ask again. Do you know exactly where these refugees came from?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. Now, this wasn't -- and again, just to be on the safe side, you're there, you're ECMM, you're there to monitor, there to learn. Did you ask, did you ask where they came from? It's a yes or no.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I'd say I did.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: And -- okay. And so might I be able to ask you where they came from then?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I cannot remember.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: But just on that issue --

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: You're taking my time, but go on. Go on?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's important.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: If you're going to tell me something you've told us already.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I didn't because -- No.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay, go for it.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yesterday on consideration about this and as I said these events like this make you think. We also came across a serious refugee situation in Gradska.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. Well, I just want to talk about this one situation here, because -- and the questions are generated from your direct examination. Now, you didn't ask where they came from. Did you ask by any chance why they came there? We don't need to know the where, but how about the why. Why did they come there? In other words, who was responsible?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: For putting them there?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Yes. I mean, for --

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I think I answered that yesterday.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. But I'm asking you to humour me again today. So what was the answer yesterday?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: The answer yesterday was, if I remember correctly, having witnessed what I witnessed that particular day --

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: No, sir.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Please let me finish.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: No, no, what I'm asking you is this.

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: I asked you where they came from?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: You said I don't know?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: I'm asking you why, in other words, why they had to leave -- you know, who drove them away, in other words, why?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: I'll answer by saying my priority, counsel, was not that. My priority was to improve these people's living standards.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: So the answer is I don't know. Is that the answer?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yeah. Yes, that is the answer.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. I understand that you want to improve their living standards. So the next question, based on that, did you get on the phone and contact ECMM to contact the European Union to provide humanitarian assistance for these people? Take them out, put them into a better facility? Did you contact them?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well --

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: No, no, just answer my question?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, I certainly contacted ECMM, for sure, and informed them of what I found. That's for definite.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: I'm not asking did you inform them what you found. Did you ask them to provide assistance, in other words, to dig into that big purse of the European Union, extract some money, buy resource -- buy food and whatever and bring it over there? Did you ask for that? That's what I'm asking?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
utterances.text: My course of action --

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: No, no, did you do that?

utterances.speaker: RAYMOND LANE [Resumed]
